_note: Which per-auto damage components REPLACE the basic attack rather than adding to it. An overlay, so a re-extraction cannot lose it, and folded in by scripts/export_engine_data.py and web/fight_engine.py.
_why: The engine charged a normal 100% AD auto AND the kit's per-auto component on top of it. For a champion whose passive IS the attack -- Graves' shotgun, Zeri's burst -- that is a phantom extra attack on every swing. Measured on a bare Graves at 0% crit: the engine produced 2.44x AD where the tooltip says 1.44x, a 69% over-count. Flagged components are charged INSTEAD of the auto, in proportion to how often they actually fire, so the base term is scaled by (1 - replaced share) rather than being dropped outright: Nocturne's Umbra Blades replaces one auto every twelve seconds, not all of them.
_provenance: Each verdict below is read off the champion's own tooltip in data/champions_wr.json, and where the tooltip could not settle it, off the League of Legends Wiki's Wild Rift data templates. The reasoning is recorded per champion because 'replaces' versus 'adds' is not recoverable from the numbers alone.
_schema: champions[name].abilities[slot] = {empowerLimit: int, components[componentName]: {replacesAuto, critVariantOf, ratioOverride, reason}}

Passive Auto (non-critical).reason: '12 Gauge: Attacks fire 4 bullets. Units hit take 72% AD physical damage +24% for additional bullets.' That sentence describes what an attack IS, not a bonus on one: 72 + 24 + 24 + 24 = 144% AD is the whole auto. The existence of a separate critical-strike line at 280% AD only makes sense if these are totals.

Passive Auto (critical).reason: 'Critical strikes fire 6 bullets, 130% damage each and increase each bullet's damage by 30%' = 130 + 30 x 5 = 280% AD. Charged at the build's crit RATE against the non-critical variant, so crit finally scales Graves' actual attack. It was flagged alt and filtered out entirely, which left crit worth 1.43x on his auto where the game says 1.94x.

Living Battery.reason: 'Living Battery: Fires a burst of 6 rounds in the target direction, dealing 13-21 (+105-125% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit.' Her basic attack IS the burst; there is no separate normal auto underneath it.

Umbra Blades.reason: 'Every 12 seconds, Nocturne's next attack is empowered to strike the target and nearby enemies for 70 (120% AD) physical damage.' The empowered attack deals 120% AD; it is not 100% plus 120%. Only the empowered auto is replaced, which the share already handles.

P._why_empower_limit: 'Every 12 seconds, Nocturne's next attack is empowered' -- one attack, and the 12s gate is not otherwise modelled.

Ruthless Predator.reason: 'Empowers the next attack to strike twice, stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing 20/60/100/140 (+150% AD) physical damage.' The stated figure is what the empowered attack deals in total across both strikes.

2._why_empower_limit: 'Empowers the NEXT ATTACK to strike twice' -- one attack per cast.

Power Fist.reason: NOT bonus damage. The Wild Rift data template gives 'gain 50 bonus attack range and critically strike' with 'Critical Damage: 180/200/220/240%'. It is a critical strike with a modified multiplier, so 180% AD is 180% OF the attack, not 180% on top of it.

3._why_empower_limit: 'Empowers his next attack to critically strike' -- one attack per cast.

Twin Bite First Hit.reason: 'Empowers Shyvana's next attack to strike twice, dealing 58 (100% AD) and 12 (20-80% AD) physical damage respectively.' The FIRST hit at 100% AD is the normal attack restated, so adding it to the base auto counted the same swing twice. The second hit is the genuine bonus and is left alone.

1._why_empower_limit: 'Empowers Shyvana's next attack to strike twice' -- one attack per cast.

Thundering Smash Proc.reason: CORRECT AS IT STANDS, recorded so it is not 'fixed' later. 'Volibear's next Attack deals 15/40/65/90 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and Stuns the target.' The ratio is on BONUS attack damage and reads as damage added to the attack, not as the attack's total.

1._why_empower_limit: 'Volibear's NEXT Attack deals ... and Stuns the target' -- one attack per cast.

Double Strike.reason: A genuine bonus, but the VALUE was wrong. The Wild Rift data template reads 'Master Yi's next basic attack is empowered to consume the stacks and strike twice, the second strike dealing 50% AD physical damage'. Extraction stored 150% AD, three times the real figure. The first strike is the normal auto and is already counted.

Ashe._why_drop_mechanics: Ashe does NOT have a multi-shot basic attack. Extraction invented 'multiShot: 5 shots x 40%', which the engine turned into a permanent 2.0x multiplier on every auto she throws -- and which then tripped the double-count guard and silently skipped her actual passive. Ranger's Focus is a temporary ability flurry and is already modelled as its own per-auto components on slot 1.

autoBonus.reason: Frost Shot, from the League of Legends Wiki's Wild Rift data template: basic attacks deal bonus physical damage of '10% (+ 0%-75% (+ 0%-30%)) (based on critical strike chance) of the attack's damage', and 'critical strikes do not deal any additional damage' -- they increase the slow instead. So crit chance is a damage stat for Ashe and crit DAMAGE is not, which is the exact opposite of how every other marksman reads. The inner 0-30% is Infinity Edge's own clause and is applied only when Infinity Edge is in the build.

Frost Shot.reason: Extraction stored the passive as a flat '110% AD' per-auto component. It is not flat AD at all: it is a percentage OF THE ATTACK scaling with crit chance, which autoBonus above now carries. Left in place it would double-count the same passive.

Ranger's Focus Flurry (Rank1).reason: Four components, one per rank, ALL flagged alt, so Ashe's Q scored nothing. Collapsed into one rank-scaled ratio, which is what extraction should have produced. 'While active, her attack is TRANSFORMED into a flurry of arrows, dealing 115-130% physical damage', so it replaces the attack. Treated as continuous: the ability has no cooldown, it is gated on four attack stacks which a marksman builds in about two seconds, and it lasts six -- the same assumption already baked into its attack-speed steroid.

Volley Arrow (Rank1).reason: The mirror image of the all-alt bug. Volley's four rank variants are all flagged live, so the engine summed ALL FOUR at once, and then multiplied each by its own arrow count. 'Ashe fires 5/7/9/11 arrows IN A CONE' -- a single target is hit by one arrow, not all of them, so the count belongs to an area-damage model the engine does not have. Collapsed to one rank-scaled component at one hit. Volley was reading 6,470 damage over two casts against a 2,600 HP target, which is 86% of her simulated output and why the optimiser wanted ability haste on a crit marksman.

Volley Arrow (Rank2).reason: Rank 2 of the same ability; rank scaling now lives on the Rank1 component's base sequence.

Volley Arrow (Rank3).reason: Rank 3 of the same ability; rank scaling now lives on the Rank1 component's base sequence.

Volley Arrow (Rank4).reason: Rank 4 of the same ability; rank scaling now lives on the Rank1 component's base sequence.

GNAR!.reason: The ultimate's only damage component. Nothing to double-count.

Frozen Tomb (Enemy).reason: The enemy-facing half of the ultimate, and its only damage component. The self-cast half is not damage.

Swipe.reason: The cougar-form half of a dual ability. Its only damage component; Primal Surge is a heal.

Empower.reason: Jax's W and his only W damage. 'Empowers the NEXT ATTACK or Leap Strike to deal an additional 55/100/145/190 (+60% AP)'.

2._why_empower_limit: 'Empowers the next attack' -- one attack per cast.

Full Tilt Empower.reason: Full Tilt's empowered attack, its only damage component.

3._why_empower_limit: An empowered next attack, one per cast.

Switcheroo! Fishbones.reason: Fishbones is a WEAPON STANCE, not a bonus: 'Attacks cost mana but gain range and explode to deal 112% damage to the target'. The 112% is what the attack deals, so it replaces rather than adds. Treated as continuous because it is a toggle with no cooldown; the single-target difference from the minigun is only 12%, so the choice of stance barely moves the number either way.

Whisper 4th Shot.reason: 'The final bullet will critically strike and deal additional 11% missing Health physical damage.' Jhin's defining passive, scoring zero purely because of the alt flag. His everyNHit n=4 gate already existed and was correct, so the fourth-shot timing needed nothing.

Lightning Grenade Total.reason: UPGRADE!!! empowers ONE next ability, so only one of its four components can apply per cast and reviving them all would be wrong. The two turret components are per-auto and belong to his turret rather than his own attacks. Of the two per-cast options this is the smaller (300 + 180% AP against Rocket Swarm's 524 + 175%), so it is the conservative choice.

Wind Slash (min).reason: Wind Slash is charged, dealing 100-300 base and 60-180% AD depending on how long it is held, and BOTH ends were flagged alt so her ultimate scored nothing. The minimum is taken on purpose: assuming a fully charged ult on every cast flatters the champion, and under-rating is the safer error in a build optimiser.

_why_empower_limit: perAutoShare returns 1 -- every auto -- unless the ability declares an empowerLimit, and that limit is recovered by a regex looking for 'empowers the next THREE attacks'. An ability that empowers 'the next attack', singular, has no word for the regex to read, so it matched nothing and the empowered swing was applied to EVERY auto in the fight. Stated explicitly here instead. The engines already prefer an explicit empowerLimit over the regex, so nothing in them had to change for this.
_why_auto_bonus: A champion whose CRIT CHANCE converts into flat bonus attack damage, and whose critical strikes therefore deal no extra damage. Only Ashe. Modelled as a multiplier on the attack plus a hard crit-damage disable, because that is literally what the tooltip describes.
_why_unset_alt: An ability whose damage components are ALL flagged `alt` scores ZERO. The engines filter on `!alt` to stop a base-plus-variant pair being counted twice, which is right when there is a base to keep; when every component is a variant it deletes the ability outright. Ten abilities across ten champions were in that state, including Jhin's passive, Jinx's rocket launcher, Jax's W and Riven's ultimate. Exactly ONE component is revived per ability, chosen below, and the rest stay alt so nothing double-counts.
